semanticFindings: daily source row identity != economic event identity
new source publication date != new economic primitive
article/disclosure count cannot be used as independent confirmation count without event clustering
explicit announcement periods are direct evidence that some official rows are designed to recur across dates
same-day short-interval stability does not authenticate publisher-native revision history
no native provider item/version/supersession identifier has been proven
capturedAt remains the conservative replay availability bound until API availability timing is authenticated
biasAndFalsification: No price, return, sentiment, rank, threshold or outcome was inspected.
All physically observed recurring examples came from source-only snapshots rather than outcome-selected names.
Old-only rows are not labeled cancelled or resolved.
Cross-day recurrence is not evidence that all repeated rows are identical versions; content hashes/version semantics must still be preserved.
Official disclosure clustering does not validate general-news syndication clustering or commercial news licensing.

D17_09.basis: Two independent cross-day official snapshots physically demonstrate recurring/republication rows for the same issuer and fact date, with explicit multi-month announcement periods. Derived event clustering and republication detection are therefore Taiwan PIT/source-feasible while native correction lineage remains UNKNOWN.

D17_01.reason: Official truth lane is stronger, but licensed production general-news coverage and complete source/version governance remain unresolved.

D17_02.reason: Source publication clock is visible and capturedAt replay is safe, but true API first-availability latency/completeness remains unauthenticated.

D11_08.reason: Material-disclosure clock is observable, but publisher-native revision/completeness and authenticated intraday first-known availability are still incomplete.

exactNext: Acquire at least one additional independent official capture session plus after-hours coverage with expected/observed poll accounting.
Classify future content-hash changes separately from republication and preserve all versions append-only.
Continue search for native MOPS correction/supersession linkage; if absent, derived lineage stays explicitly non-authoritative.
Keep D17-01/02 and D11-08 L2 until their distinct missing gates close.
Do not open D17-09 return/alpha outcomes until a prospective/OOS cluster-level study is preregistered.
